For a new Indian clothing store, these are three purchase-ready options:

Provider	Current price	Important limitations / terms
Cashfree Payments	0% platform fee up to ₹20 lakh GMV under its new-merchant offer; then 1.95% + GST. 
Cashfree
	Offer applies to eligible domestic payments and ends when ₹20 lakh is used or the campaign ends; EMI, Amex, Diners, international and some other methods are excluded.
PhonePe PG	0% promotional fee; standard displayed rate 1.99%. 
PhonePe
	Promotion is conditional/time-limited. Supports UPI, cards and net banking; zero setup and AMC.
Razorpay	2% + GST; currently advertises 0% platform fees for the first 90 days. 
Razorpay
	No setup/AMC; promotional pricing has eligibility limits. Custom pricing is available above roughly ₹5 lakh/month.

Practical buying point: For a new clothing store, compare the effective fee after promotions, settlement timing, refund/chargeback costs, and Shopify/WooCommerce integration—not just the headline UPI rate.

What makes switching difficult: all three are relatively easy because you replace the whole scent family rather than hunting for separately matching products. The main friction is re-buying multiple products when one runs out, especially if you prefer a particular perfume concentration.

For lowest switching cost, Nykaa is the simplest. For a more substantial layering experience, Sol de Janeiro gives you the clearest ready-made system.
